# release-tag.yml

<link-summary>Inputs, secrets and outputs of the reusable workflow Release.</link-summary>

```text
The release of one package, started by the push of its tag: v1.2.3 for a single package,
<package>-v1.2.3 for a member of a workspace (both patterns are inputs).

  parse    the tag names a package, carries its pubspec.yaml version and is on the release branch
  verify   analyze, test, inspectra check of the package and the workspace root, pub publish --dry-run
  compile  native binaries of the package's executables (dart-compile.yml)
  build    the app builds of a Flutter app (flutter-build.yml)
  publish  pub.dev with automated publishing (pub-publish.yml)
  release  the GitHub release with notes, assets, checksums and attestations (github-release.yml)

Every stage has a toggle; auto stages run when the package has what they need. The caller grants
contents: write, id-token: write and attestations: write. GitHub starts no workflow when more
than three tags are pushed at once; push the tags of a workspace release in batches of three.
```

```yaml
jobs:
  release-tag:
    uses: davils-com/workflows/.github/workflows/release-tag.yml@v1
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `working-directory` | string | `.` | Directory of the root pubspec.yaml, relative to the repository root. |
| `discovery` | string | empty | Packages discovered before; empty discovers them here. |
| `include` | string | empty | Globs of package directories outside the workspace. |
| `exclude` | string | empty | Globs of package directories to leave out. |
| `tag` | string | empty | The release tag; empty takes github.ref_name. |
| `tag-patterns` | string | `{"single":"v{version}","package":"{package}-v{version}"}` | JSON object of tag patterns with {package} and {version}. |
| `release-branch` | string | `main` | Branch the tagged commit has to be on; empty skips the check. |
| `sdk` | string | `stable` | Dart SDK (stable, beta or a version). |
| `flutter-version` | string | `stable` | Flutter version for Flutter packages. |
| `verify-enabled` | boolean | `true` | Analyze and test the package before anything is published. |
| `test-command` | string | empty | Replaces the test command of the verification. |
| `inspectra-enabled` | string | `auto` | false turns it off; otherwise inspectra check runs for the package and the workspace root when the package has an Inspectra configuration. |
| `inspectra-install` | string | `auto` | How Inspectra is installed (auto, dev-dependency, global, binary). |
| `compile-enabled` | string | `auto` | false turns it off; otherwise native binaries are compiled when the package has executables. |
| `compile-targets` | string | `["linux-x64","linux-arm64","macos-arm64","macos-x64","windows-x64"]` | JSON array of compile targets. |
| `flutter-build-enabled` | string | `auto` | false turns it off; otherwise the app is built when the package is a Flutter app. |
| `flutter-targets` | string | `{"web":"auto"}` | JSON object of Flutter build targets (see flutter-build.yml). |
| `build-environment` | string | empty | Environment of the build jobs, for signing secrets stored in an environment. |
| `publish-enabled` | string | `auto` | false turns it off; otherwise the package is published to pub.dev when it is publishable. |
| `pub-environment` | string | `pub.dev` | GitHub environment of the pub.dev publication, as named in the pub.dev settings. |
| `dry-run` | boolean | `false` | Run everything but publish nothing to pub.dev and create no release. |
| `wait-for-siblings` | boolean | `true` | Wait until the sibling packages are on pub.dev. |
| `wait-attempts` | number | `60` | How often to ask pub.dev for a sibling. |
| `wait-interval` | number | `30` | Seconds between two attempts. |
| `pre-publish` | string | empty | Shell commands run in the package directory right before the publication. |
| `github-release-enabled` | boolean | `true` | Create the GitHub release. |
| `notes-source` | string | `auto` | auto, inspectra, changelog, file, generate or keep (see github-release.yml). |
| `notes-file` | string | empty | For notes-source file, the path relative to the working directory. |
| `attest` | boolean | `true` | Attest the build provenance of the release assets. |
| `checksums` | boolean | `true` | Attach a checksums.txt. |
| `latest-package` | string | empty | In a workspace, the package whose releases become the latest release. |
| `release-mode` | string | `auto` | auto, create or update (see github-release.yml). |
| `draft` | boolean | `false` | Create the GitHub release as a draft. |
| `make-latest` | string | `auto` | auto, true or false (see github-release.yml). |
| `android-signing` | string | `auto` | auto, true or false (see flutter-build.yml). |
| `apple-signing` | string | `auto` | auto, true or false (see flutter-build.yml). |
| `runners` | string | `{}` | JSON object of runner labels. |
| `timeout-minutes` | number | `45` | Timeout of the verification. |
| `harden-runner` | boolean | `true` | Run step-security/harden-runner first on Linux runners. |
| `harden-runner-egress-policy` | string | `audit` | audit or block. |
| `harden-runner-allowed-endpoints` | string | empty | Endpoints allowed with the block policy, space separated. |
| `pre-setup` | string | empty | Shell commands run in every job before any tool is set up. |
| `post-setup` | string | empty | Shell commands run in every job after the dependencies are resolved. |
| `pub-hosted-url` | string | empty | URL of a private package host; its token is the secret PUB_HOSTED_TOKEN. |
| `git-host` | string | `github.com` | Host of private git dependencies; its token is the secret GIT_DEPS_TOKEN. |

## Secrets

All secrets are optional.

- `PUB_HOSTED_TOKEN`
- `GIT_DEPS_TOKEN`
- `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64`
- `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`
- `ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS`
- `ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD`
- `APPLE_CERTIFICATE_P12_BASE64`
- `APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD`
- `APPLE_PROVISIONING_PROFILES_BASE64`
- `APPLE_TEAM_ID`
- `APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID`
- `APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID`
- `APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_P8_BASE64`

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `package` | The released package. |
| `version` | The released version. |
| `release-url` | URL of the GitHub release. |

## Permissions the caller grants

- `attestations: write`
- `contents: write`
- `id-token: write`
